description:
We are seeking a UI/UX Developer to shape the user experience and visual design of digital products. This role combines user research, interface design, and front-end development to deliver intuitive, consistent experiences across multiple applications.
The developer translates user needs into wireframes, interactive prototypes, and functional interface components. Working closely with product managers and developers, this individual creates cohesive, human-centered solutions that address user needs and align with the product’s visual identity.
Required Clearance Level: Active TS/SCI with Polygraph

Key Responsibilities
 

 
 Conduct user research to understand user needs, behaviors, and challenges.



 
 Translate research findings and requirements into wireframes and interactive prototypes.



 
 Design cohesive, human-centered interfaces that improve usability across applications.



 
 Develop front-end components using React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.



 
 Apply color theory and grid systems to create effective layouts and visual hierarchies.



 
 Collaborate with product managers and developers to refine requirements and implement solutions.



 
 Ensure implemented interfaces accurately reflect approved designs.



 
 Review interfaces for usability, visual consistency, and attention to detail.



 
 Incorporate user and stakeholder feedback into design iterations.






Required Qualifications

 Must be fully cleared TS/SCI with a polygraph 

 Must be willing and able to work fully onsite at the location listed in this posting 


 

 
 Experience conducting user research and applying findings to interface design.



 
 Experience creating wireframes.



 
 Proficiency with digital design tools.



 
 Proficiency with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.



 
 Experience with modern front-end technologies such as React and Next.js.



 
 Strong understanding of color theory and grid systems.






Preferred Qualifications
 
 

 
 Experience with prototyping tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.



 
 Familiarity with accessibility standards and practices, including WCAG and ARIA.



 
 Experience with responsive and mobile-first design.



 
 Knowledge of design systems and reusable component libraries.



 
 Experience designing animations and micro-interactions.



 
 Experience conducting usability testing.



 
 Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies.






 #CJ



Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Software Development, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements.
